subject: Close-the-loop scoring pass and narrative stitch for QBR
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: qbr-facilitator@consultco.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Close-the-loop scoring pass and narrative stitch for QBR

Team —

As we finalize the packet for next week's QBR, I want a quick, targeted pass to close the loop on scores and the leader narratives. Attached is scoresheet_proposed_v3.xlsx with my suggested adjustments (lightly annotated). Please do two things by EOD Friday (US-PST):

1) In the linked sheet, write a one-line rationale for any score you change (column: "score_rationale").
2) Drop any concrete evidence links (Drive/Jira/notes) into the evidence column; if you need a new artifact, flag it and include owner.

Big asks: call out any contested objectives (I'll escalate to exec sync), and for any drop >0.5 points include a mitigation line (why it dropped, short-term corrective). We need tidy narratives for the presenter pack — 2 short bullets per objective: signal and ask.

Attachments: scoresheet_proposed_v3.xlsx (my pass).

I will consolidate on Wednesday and publish the final CSV. If anyone is unavailable, reply here with delegate.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Product & Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:02:14 -0800
Subject: Re: Close-the-loop scoring pass and narrative stitch for QBR

On Tue, Nov 24, 2026 at 9:15 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> As we finalize the packet for next week's QBR, I want a quick, targeted pass to close the loop on scores and the leader narratives...

Quick pass from me: I reviewed OKR Group A (Revenue & GTM). Proposed changes are in the sheet; highlights below so you don't have to open everything.

- OBJ A1 (New logo ARR): change 3.8 -> 3.3. Rationale: weighted pipeline fell short due to two large deals sliding into next quarter (pipeline notes linked). Evidence: HubSpot opportunity exports + call notes (Drive link in sheet). Mitigation: added short-term demand gen push and CS uplift for two named accounts.
- OBJ A2 (Expansion/unit economics): keep 4.0 but add note on pricing experiments not rolled out in time.

I attached a small evidence pack with our top three commercial call excerpts and the two slipped deal summaries (evidence_pack_marissa.zip).

Open question: for cross-org signal (OBJ C3) I flagged a half-point downgrade; that one will need a 1-sentence rationale in the presenter narrative (I put a suggested sentence in the sheet).

If no objections, I'll update the narrative bullets for A1/A2 and ping you with copy for the slides.

—Marissa
Sr. Director, GTM Strategy

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 12:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Close-the-loop scoring pass and narrative stitch for QBR

On Tue, Nov 24, 2026 at 10:02 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick pass from me: I reviewed OKR Group A (Revenue & GTM)...

Thanks Marissa — I pulled through customer feedback and a few CS metrics into the evidence column. One datapoint to highlight: churn from mid-market pilot cohort increased 2.2% MoM after the recent UI change; I uploaded the call transcripts and a short extract (customer_quotes_1106.pdf).

Proposed score tweak: OBJ B4 (Reliability & Latency SLO adoption) 4.5 -> 4.0. Rationale: adoption is strong but we missed the SLO instrumentation rollout target for all dedicated customers; the gap is in rollout sequencing not engineering. Suggested mitigation bullet for the narrative: "Sequencing issue — accelerated rollout plan to complete in Q1, owner: @laura_bennett."

I also left a short presenter-ready sentence for OBJ B4 in the doc: "Adoption is healthy among pilot customers; rollout sequencing will be completed next quarter, which reduces near-term confidence."

Attachment: customer_quotes_1106.pdf (quotes used for the presenter slide).

Laura
Director, Customer Success

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:08:33 -0800
Subject: Re: Close-the-loop scoring pass and narrative stitch for QBR

Ack — reviewed. One tiny wording ask on OBJ A1 narrative: change 'pipeline slide' to 'sales momentum slide' (helps when we talk to finance). No score change from me.

Ben
Head of Revenue Operations

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: qbr-facilitator@consultco.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:42:00 -0800
Subject: Finalize: scoreset and owner-action list (publishing Wednesday)

Thanks all — good notes. Final decisions below (I updated the master sheet and exported final_score_summary.csv attached).

Final score summary (selected):
- OBJ A1: 3.3 (owner: Marissa) — rationale: two large deals slipped, mitigation: focused demand gen + CS plays
- OBJ A2: 4.0 (owner: Marissa) — rationale: pricing experiments delayed
- OBJ B4: 4.0 (owner: Laura) — rationale: rollout sequencing; adoption intact
- OBJ C3: 3.0 (owner: Vivek) — rationale: cross-org signal weaker than expected due to integration delays

Action items (owners, due dates):
- Marissa: update presenter bullets for A1/A2 and upload slide copy -> Mon 11/29 EOD
- Laura: finalize instrumentation rollout timeline + one-slide recovery plan -> Mon 11/29 EOD
- Ben: adjust slide language "pipeline" -> "sales momentum" in deck and confirm finance-ready numbers -> Tue 11/30 EOD
- Vivek: consolidate final CSV and publish packet to Drive; coordinate runbook for QBR rehearsal -> Wed 12/1 09:00 PST

Related: I added the customer quote PDF and Marissa's evidence pack to the folder, and pinged consultco to confirm facilitation logistics. If nobody raises a formal dispute by EOD Monday I'll lock these scores for the presenter packet.

Attachments: final_score_summary.csv

Cheers — Vivek
Head of Product & Ops, Redwood Inference
